newsitem.title: USA: CBOT old crop soybeans and meal fall sharply.
newsitem.headline: CBOT old crop soybeans and meal fall sharply.

text.p: CBOT old crop soybean and soymeal futures fell sharply as cash basis levels crumbled, pit sources said.
"The cash market has collapsed," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter.
Traders said Cargill Inc was a featured seller of at least 700,000 bushels of August.

Cash soybean basis levels have fallen sharply in recent days as farmer selling picked up. Cash sources said end-users were covered for spot shipment and preferred to hold out for cheaper new crop supplies when possible.
Strong world demand this year has strained old crop supplies but traders are expecting a record new crop production this fall.
At 1035 CDT, soybeans were down 15 cents per bushel to up four with August down 15 at $7.52 a bushel. Soymeal was off $4.50 per ton to up $1.30 with August down $4.50 at $251.80.
